**Autoplay block - non-negotiable.** Browsers refuse to autoplay video-with-audio until the user has interacted with the origin. Viewer sees a black screen until they tap. ALWAYS: `<video autoplay playsinline muted>` in HTML, `remoteVideo.muted = true` BEFORE `srcObject = sub.stream`, surface a 'Tap to unmute' overlay, on click set muted=false and call play().

**Cellular subscribers fail without TURN relay.** Address-port-restricted-cone NAT (most carriers) drops CF's inbound RTP after a few seconds of sparse RTCP. bm.broadcast.subscribe auto-retries once with `iceTransportPolicy: 'relay'` if the default ICE policy doesn't reach 'connected' in 10s.

**SFU not bm.room.** Peer-mesh signaling over `bm.room()` works for video calls between ≤4 people. For livestream or any 1:N broadcast, use bm.broadcast - peer-mesh chokes at 5 viewers because the publisher uploads N copies through its own uplink.

**Cache invalidation is automatic.** The bm SDK itself (/_internal/bm.js) is versioned by content-hash, and served HTML rewrites /static/*.js references to `?v=<hash>` covering every file under static/. A `benmore push` propagates to every browser on the next load - no CF cache purge ever needed.

**SFU credentials come from the host unless the app brings its own.** Apps deployed on benmore.ai inherit working SFU automatically - no per-app config. Where neither the host nor the app has credentials, publish answers 503 `{error:'SFU not configured', reason}` (the reason names the settings to supply) and subscribe 503 `{error:'SFU not configured'}`. An app may bring its own Cloudflare app with BOTH SFU_CF_APP_ID and SFU_CF_APP_TOKEN (likewise TURN_CF_APP_ID + TURN_CF_APP_TOKEN for TURN); the id and token always come from one scope, so setting only the id or only the token uses the host's pair, and the id must be hex. A Cloudflare failure is a 503 `{error:'upstream SFU unavailable'|'SFU rejected offer'|'SFU rejected pull', request_id}` without the upstream body (it is in the server log under that request id). Tell it from the unconfigured 503 by `error` (`SFU not configured`). TURN: `/api/_webrtc/ice` adds TURN from the app's own provider when it sets one, else from the provider its host has configured (hosted apps use the platform's with no config); with neither it answers STUN only. Per app: `TURN_PROVIDER=cloudflare` with `TURN_CF_APP_ID` + `TURN_CF_APP_TOKEN`, or `TURN_PROVIDER=static` with `TURN_URL`, `TURN_USERNAME`, `TURN_CREDENTIAL` (returned unchanged to every caller that gets TURN).

**Chat alongside broadcast** - store messages in a `messages` table (NOT pure WS broadcast - reload erases history). Mark the table `access.read: anon` so every viewer sees the full insert event. Use the cursor-based fetch pattern: keep `lastId`, on each `bm.live('messages', …)` event, fetch newer rows.
